meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

copy.tagline: 用访谈式提问帮您打磨计划与设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常常需要把不成熟的想法梳理得清晰可行
copy.tagline_en: Hone your plan or design through relentless questioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to sharpen rough ideas into clear plans.

howto.what: 装上后,你可以用它发起一场持续追问的访谈,用来打磨计划或设计。技能本身只做一件事:执行一次 /grilling 会话。
howto.when: 原文标注了 disable-model-invocation,Claude 不会自行调用它;需要你显式触发(例如 /grill-me),才会开始这场 /grilling 会话。

say.text: 用 grill-me 拷问一下我的这份计划
say.note: 随后会进入一次 /grilling 访谈会话

say.text: /grill-me 帮我打磨这个设计方案
say.note: 开始针对设计反复追问

howto.what_en: Once installed, it lets you start a relentless interview session (/grilling) to sharpen a plan or design. The skill itself does one thing: it runs that /grilling session.
howto.when_en: The skill sets disable-model-invocation, so Claude never calls it on its own. You trigger it explicitly (e.g. /grill-me), and the /grilling session begins.

say_en.text: Use grill-me to grill my plan

say_en.note: Begins a relentless Q&A on the design

say_en.text: grill-me: challenge my plan, don't hold back
